body.message:
Thank you. I’m just a little confused about the rate, as you previously confirmed that the advertised AED 25,000/month is fully all-inclusive, covering all utility bills, taxes and fees.

Based on that rate, 14 nights would be approximately AED 11,667 on a pro-rata basis, while the quote we received is AED 16,337.30.

Could you please clarify why the 14-night rate is significantly higher than the advertised monthly rate?
